text:
incidents-bot: [page] GPU capacity exhaustion detected in eu-west-1 pool — queue length spike -> ~4000 pending requests, throttling observed. Pager: @Maya (oncall-ingest)
Maya (oncall-ingest): ack. looking at graphs now. pulling logs and autoscaler events.
Amber (sre): queue size + autoscaler errors trending. autoscaler logs show repeated 'scale-up suppressed - provider quota' around 00:08 UTC.
Dan (eng-runtime): runtime reports KV cache pressure and many long-lived streams. some clients sending long sequences that blow memory.
Priya (eng-platform): provider API returned rate limit/429 for instance creation attempts. we retried and got further 429s.
Miguel (support): seeing uptick in customer 504/503s. Support channel lighting up. Miguel -> escalating to CS.
Olivia (cs): acknowledged. notifying impacted accounts with a short status message. collecting customer IDs for SLA impact assessment.
Maya (oncall-ingest): immediate mitigations: 1) enable emergency-burst routing to us-east, 2) reduce batch sizes on eu-west, 3) pause best-effort/low-priority jobs.
Jonas (infra): checking quotas — eu-west GPU quota is at limit. there's a pending quota request from earlier but not yet approved.
Amber (sre): while quota increase pending we should route new traffic to eu-central or us-east. Is cross-region fallback enabled?
Dan (eng-runtime): fallback exists but not automatic for all routes. I'll flip a config to prefer eu-central then us-east for non-SLA customers.
Priya (eng-platform): approving routing change. pushing policy now; ETA ~5m to roll.
Maya (oncall-ingest): go ahead. also enable degraded_model flag to serve smaller quantized variants for impacted customers to reduce memory per-session.
Dan (eng-runtime): applying degraded-model toggle: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/flags -d '{"flag":"degraded_model","scope":"eu-west"}'``` — executed.
incidents-bot: deploybot: routing-change rollout started (run-id: 83f2). monitor /deploys/83f2 for progress.
Maya (oncall-ingest): queue dropped from ~4000 -> ~900 after initial routing adjustments. 5xx rate dropped but still elevated (~2.8%).
Miguel (support): support dashboards show fewer errors. triaging customers with highest retries first.
Olivia (cs): drafted customer note offering temporary credits and ETA for remediation — will send once we confirm steady state.
Jonas (infra): provider replied: quota increase approved but provisioning ETA ~28m. We can manually spin up instances in us-east as emergency measure. opinions?
Priya (eng-platform): manual spin-up ok if we update LB weights after instances are ready. I'll coordinate.
Dan (eng-runtime): lowering default batch size from 8 -> 4 in eu-west to reduce memory pressure. disabling prefetch for best-effort queues as well.
Maya (oncall-ingest): executing priority eviction for best-effort jobs: ```kubectl patch job best-effort --patch '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'``` — jobs paused.
Amber (sre): create an alert to correlate provider 429s with queue-length spikes and autoscaler suppression. I'll file an ops ticket and link here.
Maya (oncall-ingest): handoff plan: I'll remain until next rotation in ~30m, then handoff to Amber. tagging incident SEV3 for now (customer-impacting but active mitigation).
Amber (sre): collecting logs and timeline. will assemble into incident notes at /incidents/2135791024/timeline.md.
Dan (eng-runtime): preliminary root cause: sudden traffic burst with long sequence lengths causing memory pressure + provider regional GPU quota reached -> autoscaler couldn't scale, resulting in queue growth and throttling.
Priya (eng-platform): follow-ups: (A) request warm standby/prewarmed instances in eu-west, (B) implement cross-region routing fallback for more routes, (C) surface provider quota errors as a high-severity alert.
Miguel (support): attaching customer list and sample error traces to the incident doc for CS/reference.
Olivia (cs): scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 08:30 UTC. inviting eng-runtime, infra, product, and account teams for impacted customers.
Maya (oncall-ingest): current status: queue stabilized ~200, 5xx ~0.7%. keeping incident open until postmortem items are tracked. handing off monitoring to Amber in 25m.
Amber (sre): ack. will watch and publish action items. thanks all for quick coordination.
incidents-bot: Incident updated — severity: SEV3, status: mitigated, responders: [Maya, Amber, Dan, Priya, Jonas, Miguel, Olivia]
